rationale: BSY gapped up ~4.2% on a day when SPY is down 4.06% and VIXY is up 26.83%, suggesting idiosyncratic strength (likely earnings or corporate event), but the stock is now trading well below both VWAP ($47.12) and the 9-EMA ($46.20), sitting at only 28.7% of today's range after fading from a high of $48.17.
